outcome: Cord Blood Thyroid Stimulating Hormone (CBTSH) levels
cohort: The study included 106 neonates from the neonatal ward of a tertiary care hospital in urban south Karnataka, India.
finding: The study found a significant association between CBTSH levels and various maternal and perinatal factors, with higher levels observed in preterm neonates, those with an APGAR score <7, normal vaginal delivery, primigravida status, male sex, and low birth weight.
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery was significantly associated with higher cord blood TSH levels.
birth_weight: Babies with low birth weight were included and found to have higher CBTSH levels.
gest_age: Preterm babies were included and found to have higher CBTSH levels.
